635:t_021:3.en:
$$カズミ$$
「The source of the gravity anomaly... Maybe I should just call it a $$変動重力源$$...」

635:t_021:4.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「To think there's a space monster like that...!」

635:t_021:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Trace complete. It appears the space monster we should call the $$変動重力源$$ was transferred here from Saturn's moon $$タイタン$$.」

635:t_021:8.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「It can't be... that thing is...!」

635:t_022:0.en:
$$チコ$$
「That $$バスターマシン$$...! It's the 《$$サーペンタイン姉妹$$》' $$カランドゥ$$!」

635:t_022:2.en:
$$ピアジェ$$
「We were transferred here too, by the power of that Eternal $$トップレス$$.」

635:t_022:4.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Are you talking about the $$変動重力源$$?!」

635:t_022:5.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「So I was right. That monster is the $$タイタン$$ Crab that was buried on $$タイタン$$.」

635:t_022:7.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「It was being excavated on $$タイタン$$ as an alien $$バスターマシン$$.」

635:t_022:8.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「But the $$サーペンタイン姉妹$$ had been eating its flesh to gain the powers of an Eternal $$トップレス$$...」

635:t_022:9.en:
$$チコ$$
「Does doing that even mean anything?!」

635:t_022:10.en:
$$ピアジェ$$
「That's no $$バスターマシン$$. It's a $$トップレス$$ that has lived for over 10,000 years.」

635:t_022:11.en:
$$ルクルト$$
「With that power, we could be Eternal $$トップレス$$ who go on forever too, and stay together, just the two of us, always.」

635:t_022:12.en:
$$ピアジェ$$
「Now then, Eternal $$トップレス$$!」

635:t_024:3.en:
$$ラルク$$
「What fools those two are... There's no way a monster like that could be an Eternal $$トップレス$$...!」

635:t_024:4.en:
$$チコ$$
「What is that power...! It's on a whole other level compared to the other $$宇宙怪獣$$!」

635:t_024:5.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「To think something like that was in the solar system...!」

635:t_024:6.en:
$$アスカ$$
「I don't care where it came from! Right now, just think about how to beat it!」

635:t_024:7.en:
$$マリ$$
「Easy for you to say, but that thing is seriously not normal!」

635:t_024:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「If the enemy isn't normal, then we will simply use a method that isn't normal either.」

635:t_024:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$$シモン$$! Thanks to the series of distortions in the dimensional boundary line since a moment ago, I was able to analyze a point of contact with another dimension!」

635:t_024:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「All that's left is to use the $$ソーラリアン$$'s event control...」

635:t_024:12.en:
$$シモン$$
「Who has time for something that roundabout?! Send me the coordinate data!」

635:t_024:14.en:
$$トライア$$
「The boss is fired up. Quit your bellyaching and do it the way he wants.」

635:t_026:0.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「You know what you're doing, $$シモン$$!」

635:t_026:1.en:
$$シモン$$
「The method is the same as when I sensed $$ニア$$ in the $$アンチスパイラル$$ universe! I've got the knack!」

635:t_026:2.en:
$$シモン$$
「Hang on, $$ニア$$! My drill is about to punch right through the dimensional wall for you!!」

635:t_027:0.en:
$$チコ$$
「No way! A hole just opened in the dimensional boundary line!」

635:t_027:2.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「W-What's going to happen?!」

635:t_027:3.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「W-What's going to happen?!」

635:t_027:4.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「This is your first time seeing it, isn't it.」

635:t_027:5.en:
$$シモン$$
「This is our $$大グレン団$$ flagship! The $$超銀河ダイグレン$$!!」

635:t_028:1.en:
$$シモン$$
「Sorry to keep you waiting, $$ニア$$! I've come to pick you up!!」

635:t_028:2.en:
$$ダヤッカ$$
「All right! We're back in normal space!」

635:t_028:3.en:
$$リーロン$$
「When the $$サイデリアル$$ captured us, I wondered what would become of us, but things do work out somehow, don't they.」

635:t_028:4.en:
$$ロージェノム$$
「Heh... nobody was despairing, though.」

635:t_028:5.en:
$$ニア$$
「I believed $$シモン$$ and everyone in $c would surely come to save us.」

635:t_028:6.en:
$$ガバル$$
「But it looks like we're in the thick of it right off the bat!」

635:t_028:7.en:
$$シベラ$$
「A space monster I've never seen, and a mass of metal...!」

635:t_028:8.en:
$$テツカン$$
「Looks like we've come out in one hell of a place...」

635:t_028:9.en:
$$アーテンボロー$$
「If it's come to this, all we can do is keep shooting!」

635:t_028:11.en:
$$ダヤッカ$$
「Shall we do it, $$シモン$$?!」

635:t_030:0.en:
$$ラルク$$
「The gigantic battleship and $$グレンラガン$$ combined and transformed into a gigantic robot!」

635:t_030:2.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「$$シモン$$'s sunglasses transformed too!」

635:t_030:3.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「$$シモン$$'s sunglasses transformed too!」

635:t_030:4.en:
$$シモン$$
「This is the $$超銀河グレンラガン$$! The trump card of $$大グレン団$$!!」

635:t_030:5.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Not bad at all! I'm all for this kind of outrageous stuff!」

635:t_030:6.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「Who'd have thought we'd end up saying the line we're always the ones hearing!」

635:t_030:7.en:
$$隼人$$
「But with this power, we can fight even a space monster that has swallowed a black hole!」

635:t_030:8.en:
$$弁慶$$
「Let's hurry up and smash that thing so the dialogue with the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ can get started!」

635:t_030:10.en:
$$シモン$$
「Yeah! We're aiming for the black hole space monster!」

635:t_030:12.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「After we beat that thing...!」

635:t_030:13.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「After we beat that thing...!」

635:t_030:16.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「All units, concentrate your attacks on the $$変動重力源$$! Take it down, for the sake of the dialogue with the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ too!」

kept_omissions: 635:t_030:8: Benkei's 始めてもらう (someone is to start the dialogue with the ELS) kept impersonal ('so the dialogue ... can get started'); likely Setsuna/Tieria but not stated

Nono's triple speaker rows (Nono / Buster Machine No. 7 / Diebuster) carry identical lines as in Japanese
